regime: Relief rally: oil plunge and weaker dollar lift metals and stocks together
takeaway: After Democrats won control of Congress, Brent oil fell almost 9% to about $95, the dollar slipped to its lowest since September and the 10-year yield dropped to about 4.88%. Gold rose about 3% to near $4,060 and silver about 5%, with gold miners up around 9%, while the S&P 500 gained 1.6% and the VIX fell back to about 17. Friday's jobs report and next Tuesday's inflation data could still swing yields and metals.
